criterion: Same frozen verifier and existing citation test must both pass in a network-disabled VM sandbox, using a fixed repo_test tool available to both arms.
design: Adaptive diagnostic repeat of the same task. Equal archive, editing and fixed acceptance test tools; treatment has model-driven memory intake. Tests reveal the frozen cases to the model, so passing does not establish generalization or production impact.
limitations: same task repeated after prior outcomes
local registration is not independently timestamped
